eyone.intro: At Eyone, I lead the digital growth strategy, brand visibility, multichannel communication and several high-impact digital projects. My role goes beyond classic operational marketing and also covers project management, partnership coordination, web development and process automation.

strategy.title: Marketing strategy, growth & acquisition
bullets: Building and rolling out multichannel marketing strategies: SEO, SEA, SMO, social media, visibility campaigns, content, newsletters, articles, WhatsApp, videos and digital assets.
Defining goals, KPIs and performance metrics: traffic, clicks, conversions, sales, transactions, organic growth and ROI.
Analyzing customer journeys and optimizing the conversion funnel, from discovery to purchase decision.
Competitive intelligence, market analysis, identifying business opportunities and proposing growth levers.
Running performance-, awareness- and acquisition-driven campaigns.

branding.title: Branding, content & communication
bullets: Building Eyone's digital presence from scratch.
Creating and managing an editorial calendar focused on SEO, brand, education and conversion.
Developing content to strengthen Eyone's credibility in the digital health ecosystem.
Coordinating institutional communication, sales materials and brand messaging.
Driving the group's visibility across several African markets.

ai.title: AI, automation & marketing productivity
bullets: Setting up AI-powered automated systems to speed up content production and marketing distribution.
Automating workflows with n8n: automated article writing, content scheduling, social media marketing and communication processes.
Using generative AI to create, optimize, rephrase and adapt multichannel content.
Building internal solutions to cut repetitive tasks and improve marketing productivity.

web.title: Web development & digital platforms
bullets: Developing and maintaining web platforms tied to Eyone Medical, Wergu Yaram, Topatoko and hospital facilities.
Building full-stack platforms with database, application logic and Firebase hosting.
Using Claude Code to speed up the design and development of functional web platforms.
Managing technical evolutions, fixes, security, performance, hosting, monitoring and updates.
Training and supporting users on some of the platforms developed.

partnerships.title: Wergu Yaram project & partnerships
bullets: Overall leadership of the Wergu Yaram project: planning, coordination, impact storytelling and operational follow-up.
Building the CSR and social impact communication strategy.
Managing relationships with institutional partners, NGOs and field stakeholders.
Organizing societal initiatives, field campaigns and community events.
Tracking impact metrics and contributing to activity reports.

management.title: Management & coordination
bullets: Leading and coordinating staff, content creators, community managers, partners and vendors.
Supporting teams in developing their digital skills.
Providing technical and marketing support to internal teams for operations, campaigns and launches.

messagesDeVie.intro: Volunteer leadership of the digital marketing of a non-profit organization committed to compassion initiatives and medical campaigns across Senegal.

strategy.title: Strategy & visibility
bullets: Defining the content strategy, coordinating social media management, influencer marketing and event communication.
Growing the visibility of field actions and showcasing social campaigns.
Leading a volunteer team of content creators, community managers and contributors.
Setting up targeted digital campaigns to boost engagement, attract new partners and support humanitarian efforts.

academieLight.intro: Teaching a full module on community management and digital marketing to students in vocational training.

training.title: Training & coaching
bullets: Teaching digital marketing fundamentals, the community manager role, content creation, social media management and the use of tools like Canva and CapCut.
Coaching more than 20 students through hands-on digital projects.
Passing on a mindset focused on craft, performance, autonomy and employability.

strategy.title: Strategy & execution
bullets: Competitive analysis, audience targeting, action-plan definition and rollout of multichannel campaigns.
Creating initiatives to increase visibility, strengthen brand reputation and generate measurable growth.

parcours.heading: My journey
parcours.p1: I'm not the type to tell you I have this MBA or that Master's in Digital Marketing (even though I do), because I'm almost entirely self-taught… It sounds contradictory, but that's exactly my strength: authentic passion and constant learning.
parcours.p2: For the little story, I never imagined I'd end up in marketing… Like every kid I wanted to be a pilot, then an engineer, then a banker and finally an entrepreneur. Digital marketing came by chance in 2021, and it became my passion!
parcours.p3: Today, I live this adventure from Dakar, at the crossroads of marketing, AI, web product and impact partnerships — proud to contribute to the digital development of French-speaking Africa.
parcours.expand: See the start of the journey (2014 – 2021)

beyond.heading: I also build through MY ONOMA.
beyond.desc: MY ONOMA is a Digital Product & Growth Studio based in Dakar. It builds products and systems for clients, builds growth machines, and develops its own products. Max-Morrys Agency is its Product, AI, Technology & Brand practice.

page.lede: I help you get a grip on digital marketing, SEO and AI — for French-speaking West Africa, with the means you actually have.
page.aloneBody: Trainer, consultant and digital content creator based in Dakar. I write the articles, I build the courses, I run the Club, and I answer the messages.
page.aloneStrong: There is nobody else behind this platform.
page.doesTrainBody: Online courses on local search and on AI applied to prospecting. Written, filmed and corrected by me.
page.doesPublishBody: A free blog, a podcast, videos. All of it in French, with examples taken from here and nowhere else.
page.doesSupportBody: Neighbourhood businesses I make findable online, and bespoke projects on the Agency side.
page.pathLede: Dates and facts, not adjectives. That's what a visitor checks before reaching for a card.
page.producedBody: These are production figures, not audience figures. I announce no students, no views and no revenue:
page.producedStrong: the platform has just opened, and an inflated number takes thirty seconds to check.
page.soloBody: Because I'd rather answer you myself. It explains everything that is capped here: the tutor quota, the workshop seats, the publishing rhythm.
page.soloStrong: Nothing is unlimited because nothing can be — and I'd rather write it than let you find out afterwards.
page.treeLede: Max-Morrys is a brand of MY ONOMA SARL. Two other practices sit alongside it, and they don't do the same thing.
page.treeLearnBody: The platform you're reading. Courses, blog, podcast, Club, and the Digital Presence offer for local businesses.
page.treeBuildBody: Bespoke projects, no public price list, on a written brief. A sister practice, not a catalogue offer.
page.treeGrowBody: Acquisition and growth. If your request belongs there, it gets passed on — never turned away.
page.treeCite: certificate of registration, Ministry of Economy (Senegal)
page.findLede: I publish elsewhere too. If you'd rather follow me there, keep your habits — I won't force you back here.
page.closingBefore: Start with the blog — it's free, and there are
page.closingAfter: articles. Or write to me directly: I'm the one who reads.
page.portraitAlt: Max-Morrys Eyoum, waist-up portrait: round glasses, green shirt, arms folded, in a bright interior.
page.slotPathBody: The milestones marked « stated » have no link you can open. The two figures that used to decorate them — traffic growth, follower count — are gone: they have no public source. I don't invent them, and I don't lift them from a third-party directory.
page.slotPathStrong: Here, proof means a link a stranger can open without taking my word.
page.slotFindBody: The profiles opposite are declared and verified one by one. What is missing: the listening platform for the podcast, which is declared nowhere.
page.slotFindStrong: I'd rather leave it empty than guess an address — and no account shows its follower count.
